instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Mid-scale restaurant chain with 12 locations serving Mediterranean cuisine. Central kitchen produces 70% of menu items for distribution to satellite locations. Evaluating kitchen display systems, AI-driven prep quantity forecasting, and centralized procurement optimization. The organization has significant capital, talent depth, and existing technology infrastructure, but internal processes are designed for stability and risk management — not speed. Innovation initiatives must navigate procurement, legal, compliance, and IT security review before receiving green-light. The key challenge is not resource availability but organizational velocity.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary objective is to reduce operating expenses by 15% over the next 2 years while maintaining current output levels. We believe there is significant waste in our manual processes and want to identify the highest-ROI automation opportunities across order processing, invoicing, and customer support workflows. We are not looking to grow headcount — we want to do more with our existing team.
answers.teamSize: Our digital and innovation organization includes 80+ professionals across centers of excellence for AI/ML, cloud engineering, UX design, and agile delivery. We run an internal incubator program that has graduated 6 new digital products to market in the past 2 years, alongside a corporate venture capital arm that makes strategic minority investments in relevant startups.

input.changes_since_last: Product launch successful — 4 new features shipped. Customer NPS improved 20 points. Backlog of technical debt growing.

opportunities.title: Centralized Supply Chain Optimization via Demand Forecasting
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging the existing centralized kitchen model, automating procurement and inventory management will directly attack waste identified in manual ordering processes. This incremental approach minimizes risk while providing a high ROI opportunity to achieve OpEx reduction goals.

first_actions: Map end-to-end ingredient flow from central kitchen to satellite locations (waste/overstock mapping).
Integrate POS data and sales forecasting tools into a single demand prediction dashboard.
Pilot the AI model on a subset of high-volume menu items for 90 days.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in inventory waste percentage by 15%
milestones: Demand forecasting model deployed and validated.
Automated, optimized procurement order cycle implemented.

opportunities.title: Unified Operational Workflow Automation (Order-to-Cash)
opportunities.rationale: The primary efficiency gap lies in manual handoffs between ordering, invoicing, and customer support. Automating these critical touchpoints will standardize operations across all 12 locations and provide the most direct path to achieving the 15% OpEx reduction goal.

first_actions: Define optimal single source of truth for customer and order data (Master Data Management).
Prioritize automation scope: Focus first on invoicing and core order capture before tackling support workflows.
Conduct a rapid process modeling workshop involving finance, IT, and operations stakeholders.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in manual intervention time per order cycle by 40%
milestones: Current state workflow process maps finalized.
MVP designed and tested for core Order-to-Invoice flow.
Pilot rollout of automated system at two representative locations.

next_steps.action: Establish a 'Process Acceleration' task force spanning Operations, IT, and Finance to cut through bureaucratic barriers.
Conduct a comprehensive 'As-Is' process mapping workshop for the top three identified manual workflows: Order Capture, Inventory Request/Waste Tracking, and Invoicing.
Define a quantifiable baseline measurement (KPI) for technical debt impact on operational velocity and system reliability.

key_weaknesses: Organizational Velocity and Bureaucracy: Internal processes are designed for stability, creating significant friction when rapid efficiency changes are required.
Process Standardization: Current manual workflows likely vary significantly across the 12 locations, preventing scalable automation.
Technical Debt Accumulation: Growing technical debt limits the ability to implement modern, integrated, and automated solutions efficiently.

improvements: Successful product launches (4 new features) demonstrate execution capability.
Measurable customer experience improvement (+20 NPS points via digital onboarding flow).
Strategic focus crystallized on clear financial goals (15% OpEx reduction).
persistent_gaps: Lack of progress on previous strategic recommendations (all marked 'not_done').
The core barrier remains organizational speed and cross-departmental process adoption.
Technical debt is creating constraints for new automation initiatives.
achieved_milestones: Successful launch and optimization of the digital customer onboarding flow, significantly improving CX time metrics.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Shift from general digital capability improvement to highly focused operational efficiency and cost reduction (OpEx). Execution capacity is proven but hampered by persistent process barriers.
